item.title: Phase 9 shipped: Private Hetzner K3s
item.description: The first provider-backed template candidate adds private management, tunneled ingress, temporary administration, and pinned K3s bootstrap.

item.title: Phase 8 shipped: Template authoring and conformance
item.description: ainfra now publishes a human and AI authoring contract, deterministic local diagnostics, and a provider-free clean-room proof.

item.title: Phase 7 shipped: Guarded MCP server mode
item.description: ainfra now exposes read-only inspection and explicitly authorized, plan-bound lifecycle operations through MCP over stdio.

item.title: Phase 6 shipped: Destruction, recovery, and hardening
item.description: Reviewed destruction, interruption recovery, retained run browsing, redaction, and lifecycle security hardening are available.

item.title: Phase 5 shipped: Output, inventory, and Ansible
item.description: Standardized non-secret output now drives deterministic inventory and controlled Ansible configuration with convergence evidence.

item.title: Phase 4 shipped: Reviewed OpenTofu plans
item.description: OpenTofu changes can be planned, reviewed, bound to immutable inputs, and applied only from the exact saved plan.

item.title: Phase 3 shipped: Immutable template sources
item.description: Local and Git-subdirectory template sources can be locked, materialized, verified by digest, and checked for drift.

item.title: Phase 2 shipped: Contracts and doctor
item.description: Deployment discovery, strict native-file contracts, deterministic doctor diagnostics, and approved local reconciliation are available.

item.title: Phase 1 shipped: Go project foundation
item.description: The compiled Go CLI, typed results, secure execution boundaries, and reproducible cross-platform build foundation are available.

item.title: Phase 0 shipped: the ainfra v1 specification
item.description: The product contract for the ainfra v1 rewrite is accepted, integrated, and ready to guide implementation.
